what: When the cursor passes over large text, only letters within 100px of the cursor fade to .3 (.3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)), and letters outside the radius return over .5s ease-in. An intro text where only the area around the cursor dims, like a flashlight’s shadow. The light type starts as dim gray text where letters inside the radius turn on in a bright text color

options.radius: Radius (px), default 100 — measured only when the cursor is inside the box that widens the panel by this much
options.look: If “light,” letters within the radius do not fade but brighten to --kf-ink (gray description text)

use:
Your big intro text here in about three lines.

· Gray text: data-fx-char-near-dim="look: light"
note: No dimming while a post is being selected (the selection range spans this post). Mouse only — not applied on touch. Text is split into word chunks (inline-block), keeping spaces as they are.
